name: Terse: wants a short, direct reply
description: A request for a short, no-elaboration reply resembles the terse_answers examples, not the detailed_answers ones
query: Please keep your reply short and to the point, no need to explain further.

name: Detailed: wants full step-by-step reasoning
description: A request for full reasoning and no skipped steps resembles the detailed_answers examples, not the terse_answers ones
query: Please explain your full reasoning and go through this step by step, don't leave anything out.

name: No preference rule matches
description: A plain factual question carries no stylistic preference cue, so it should clear neither rule's threshold
